1.description: This marks the beginning of a fresh nine-year cycle, making it the perfect time to start new projects, launch ideas, change careers, or take bold steps toward your goals. Your confidence, independence, and determination are naturally stronger, helping you create a solid foundation for the years ahead.
precautions: Avoid acting impulsively or letting impatience control your decisions
stay away from unnecessary arguments
avoid reckless behavior
avoid trusting people too quickly
practice careful planning and emotional balance

2.description: This year encourages patience, harmony, and meaningful partnerships. Instead of forcing results, allow opportunities to develop naturally. It is an excellent period for strengthening relationships, learning new skills, and preparing for future success.
positive_highlights: quiet progress leading to lasting rewards
precautions: Be mindful of mood swings
avoid emotional imbalance
watch for anxiety or unnecessary overthinking
avoid making decisions based purely on emotions
pay attention to physical and mental well-being

3.description: This is a joyful and expressive year filled with creativity, communication, and social growth. It is a wonderful time to connect with people, travel, share your ideas, and enjoy life while completing unfinished work.
positive_highlights: ideal for self-expression and personal growth
precautions: Avoid distractions
avoid gossip
watch unnecessary spending
avoid spreading yourself too thin
focus on completing existing tasks before taking on new responsibilities

4.description: This year is about building stability through discipline, patience, and consistent effort. Hard work performed now creates a strong foundation for future achievements, making it a rewarding period for long-term planning.
positive_highlights: dedication and systematic approach leading to lasting security and steady progress
precautions: May occasionally feel pressured, mentally exhausted, or frustrated
avoid becoming too rigid in thinking
prioritize health alongside responsibilities

5.description: Life becomes more dynamic and exciting during this year. Change, travel, new experiences, and unexpected opportunities are likely to appear, encouraging you to step outside your comfort zone.
positive_highlights: flexibility to make the most of changing circumstances
precautions: Stay focused
avoid impulsive decisions or unreliable commitments
handle disagreements calmly, as conflicts started during this period may become long-lasting if left unresolved

6.description: This year places greater importance on family, relationships, responsibilities, and emotional balance. It is a favorable period for strengthening personal bonds, buying a home, marriage, or contributing to your community.
precautions: Avoid becoming stubborn, selfish, or unwilling to compromise
practice open communication and flexibility to maintain peace in personal and professional relationships

7.description: This is a year of self-discovery, learning, and inner growth. Rather than chasing rapid expansion, focus on gaining wisdom, improving your skills, and developing a deeper understanding of yourself.
positive_highlights: quiet reflection leading to important breakthroughs
precautions: Avoid starting major new ventures without careful thought
control impatience, jealousy, unnecessary doubts, and emotional isolation
trust the process and focus on long-term growth

8.description: This is one of the strongest years for achievement, career growth, and financial success. Your efforts from previous years begin producing visible results, making it an excellent time to pursue ambitious goals.
precautions: Avoid greed, arrogance, or unethical decisions
stay humble
manage money wisely
ensure success is achieved with honesty and integrity

9.description: This year represents completion and transformation. It is a time to let go of what no longer serves you, finish unfinished work, forgive the past, and prepare for a fresh cycle ahead.
positive_highlights: releasing the old to create space for new beginnings
precautions: Avoid careless decisions
avoid impulsive actions
resolve conflicts rather than leaving them unresolved
avoid emotional detachment
accept endings gracefully and focus on moving forward
